note: Retired instructions are the comparison axis. Cycles are retained as diagnostics but are not a gate: laptop frequency and competing work moved them substantially while instruction slopes stayed stable. Socket rows count the complete server process tree and subtract N/2-request totals from N-request totals, removing fixed perf attachment, process startup, peer startup, and idle-loop work. The ordinary targets use 50,000 versus 25,000 requests and 64 connections. The expensive holistic dashboard uses 1,500 versus 750 requests, 8 connections and 50 warmups. The 2026-08-13 declarative extension arms use workload-sized N/N2 slopes, 8 connections, 50 warmups and five trials. Signed webhooks generate a fresh, correctly signed event id and timestamp per operation, so the row measures successful verification, replay claiming, typed decoding and dispatch rather than 409 replay refusals. The persistent WebSocket room is far below the HTTP floor; it divides a directly counted 100,000-message run by messages instead of subtracting an independently timed low run whose periodic loop work was larger than the signal. Its wide range is retained and the row is marked unresolved rather than presenting the median as precise. gRPC is measured through the native TLS/HTTP2 server; HTTP arms use native plaintext HTTP/1.1. The metal server is pinned to one physical core and the load generator elsewhere.

typical_e2e.surface: Bearer authentication plus concurrent PostgreSQL and outbound HTTP round trips, emitted as JSON

holistic_e2e.request: POST /v1/holistic/42?limit=3&page=1&size=12&sort=-score with bearer, JSON, origin, trace, session-cookie and zstd headers
holistic_e2e.surface: The deep operations-intelligence dashboard through VersionedRouter: proxy, trusted-host, global and principal rate limits, quota, request ID, server timing, CORS, CSRF, security, signed session, cache-control and zstd policy; typed path/query/header/cookie/body binding, nested Field validation, dependencies and feature flags; bearer authentication, roles, permissions and Cedar; concurrent named ORM/PostgreSQL and outbound HTTP reads; native ORM model storage, background work, compiled escaped templates and HTML emission; four DST-correct temporal ranges, native-owned 730 x 48 x 6 series projection with immutable x/value/full-path plans, prefix sums and bounds, eight LTTB reductions, eleven nine-significant-digit gap-preserving paths, eight tick axes serialized at one final text boundary, zoned recurrence, a packed 730-fix geospatial trajectory and AVX2 occupancy grid, pgvector/halfvec/sparsevec incident projections, pagination, metrics flattening, and protobuf and MessagePack exports. It has no memoized response or cache-hit path.

prior_dashboard.note: Workload growth, not a regression comparison: this revision adds the full HTTP-policy stack, versioned routing, feature flags, quota, a named native ORM query, signed-session mutation, zstd egress and background work to the same dashboard.

original_workload.surface: The same declarative request before series, temporal, geospatial, pgvector, pagination, metrics and compact-export work was added
original_workload.note: This is workload growth, not a regression comparison: the baseline deliberately compounds substantially more useful work per request.

holistic_versioned_suite.definition: One successful request through every independently measurable /v1 arm. MCP initialization is a correctness/setup arm and is deliberately excluded; one authenticated session is opened before pricing each MCP call. No arm uses response memoization or a cache-hit path.

holistic_declarative_extensions.definition: The request-time declarative surfaces added after the historical versioned-suite snapshot. Every HTTP route is mounted below /v1. The aggregate is the sum of one successful operation through each extension arm; it excludes the existing dashboard and historical protocol arms.

optimization_from_prior_baseline.scope: Metrics, Sync snapshot and Enterprise Cedar route arms re-recorded; unchanged arms retain their preceding same-day medians.

series-live.surface: Declared Series over an ORM model with a bound parameter, zoned daily spine, count/sum/average measures, top-three grouping, PostgreSQL wire round trip and dense JSON envelope

enterprise.surface: Global TenancyMiddleware, TenantHeader directory lookup and ambient binding, organization memberships and roles, and Cedar organization authorization

admin-detail.surface: Generated Admin detail route with permission access, ORM-shaped read, field projection, escaping and compiled HTML response

scim-search.surface: Generated SCIM user filter/list over the user and organization stores, authenticated as the directory principal and authorized through Cedar

sync-snapshot.surface: Bounded Sync.shape evaluation, PostgreSQL wire round trip, twelve native ORM rows, native loaded/null/primary-key scan and authoritative snapshot/key boundary

signed-webhook.request: POST /v1/webhooks/field-observations with one fresh HMAC-signed event per operation
signed-webhook.surface: WebhookHub source, explicit CSRF exemption, HMAC verification, bounded replay claim, typed FieldObservation validation and dispatch

workflow.surface: Three declared Workflow steps over a fresh operation-owned InMemoryWorkflowStore, with recorded results and completion envelope

readiness.surface: Generated health router running concurrent critical PostgreSQL and non-critical outbound service probes

metrics.surface: Generated Prometheus endpoint over a stable ProjectorSnapshot with call-owned native route labels, counters, histogram exposition and document framing

openapi.surface: Authenticated serving of the generated OpenAPI contract after startup compilation

websocket-room.request: persistent WEBSOCKET /v1/live/accounts/42 text message round trip
websocket-room.surface: Authenticated versioned WebSocket route, RoomRegistry membership, local broadcast and frame egress
websocket-room.note: Four trials clustered at 11.7k-13.0k instructions and one retired 35.7k. The median is useful as an order of magnitude, not a regression threshold; periodic server work is large relative to this native message path.

techempower_fortunes.surface: TechEmpower Fortunes request with PostgreSQL and escaped template output
